response.justification: While Bogdan has extensive experience in software architecture, distributed systems, and mentoring, his background is primarily in full-stack web development (TypeScript, Node.js) and DLang. He significantly falls short of the minimum requirement of 8 years of C++ programming, and lacks the deep compute infrastructure experience required, making him a poor fit for a C++-heavy cloud compute platform technical lead role.
strengths: Strong advocate for software craftsmanship, testing (TDD), and establishing engineering best practices.
Demonstrated technical leadership and mentoring experience through Staff-level roles, workshops, and coding dojos.
Experience building and scaling high-throughput distributed systems and microservices (e.g., handling millions of requests/sec).
concerns: Drastically misses the required 8 years of C++ programming experience, with only about 7 months of professional C/C++ work listed.
Lacks deep, specialized experience in low-level cloud compute platforms, storage, or hardware architecture.
Recent and primary technical stack (TypeScript, Node.js, React, DLang) does not align with the core technologies expected for this role.
